name: WhatsApp
tagline: Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API with templates, the 24-hour window, simulated people and signed webhooks.
point: Any bearer token (any_token is on by default)

capabilities.title: Conversations per number
capabilities.text: One row per number with the last message, the person's profile name and whether the 24 h window is open.

capabilities.title: The 24-hour window
capabilities.text: Outside the window only templates are delivered; a free text fails with 131047, as Meta reports it.

capabilities.title: Templates with review states
capabilities.text: Approved, pending, rejected, paused or disabled; each change sends message_template_status_update to the app.

capabilities.title: Parameters checked
capabilities.text: A wrong parameter count answers 132000; an undeclared template 132001, and it is listed so you can add it.

capabilities.title: People who reply
capabilities.text: reply_as_user sends a text, a template button tap, an image or a location as Meta's messages webhook.

capabilities.title: Signed webhooks
capabilities.text: Status and message webhooks carry X-Hub-Signature-256 with your app secret; the verification GET runs on demand.

capabilities.title: Tier, throughput, quality
capabilities.text: Over the throughput: 130429. Over the tier: 131056. A restricted number: 131048. Low template quality pauses it.

capabilities.title: Recipients per number
capabilities.text: Whether a number has WhatsApp, its profile name and the steps each message goes through: sent, delivered, read, failed.

excerpts.title: A conversation, as Meta would report it

callouts.title: Customer service window
callouts.text: Open for 24 h after the person's last message; outside it only templates go out.

callouts.title: Failed 131047
callouts.text: A free text sent outside the window fails, and the status webhook says so.

callouts.title: Template with buttons
callouts.text: The template as the person sees it, with its URL and quick-reply buttons.

callouts.title: Status, as the app saw it
callouts.text: accepted, sent, delivered, read: each webhook with what your app answered.

callouts.title: Provoke on this message
callouts.text: Fail it with a Meta error code, or send the read webhook again.

callouts.title: Rejected and paused
callouts.text: Sends follow the status: a paused template answers 132015, a disabled one 132016.

callouts.title: Asked for, not declared
callouts.text: The app used a template that does not exist; Stuntman answered 132001.

callouts.title: Status
callouts.text: Change it and Stuntman sends message_template_status_update to the app.

callouts.title: Quality
callouts.text: Low quality pauses the template, as Meta does.

callouts.title: Variables checked
callouts.text: The values the app sent last; a wrong count is answered 132000.

callouts.title: Expire tokens now
callouts.text: Every Graph call gets 190 OAuthException until tokens are restored.

callouts.title: Signed with the app secret
callouts.text: Webhooks carry X-Hub-Signature-256, so the app's check is tested.

callouts.title: Verification request
callouts.text: Sends Meta's hub.challenge GET and checks the app echoes it.

callouts.title: Messaging tier
callouts.text: Unique numbers a day; over it the send fails with 131056.

callouts.title: number.yaml
callouts.text: The same settings as a file: ids, access, webhook, limits and quality.

provoke.name: Broken connection
provoke.what: The connection resets, answers nothing, or hangs

provoke.name: Expired token
provoke.what: Every Graph call gets 190 "Session has expired"

provoke.name: Outside the window
provoke.what: A free text after 24 h without a reply fails 131047
provoke.how: send a text while get_window says closed

provoke.name: Template paused
provoke.what: Sends with it fail 132015; disabled gives 132016

provoke.name: Failed with a code
provoke.what: A sent message turns failed with the Meta error you pick

provoke.name: Duplicate status webhook
provoke.what: The same status webhook arrives again

provoke.name: Bad webhook signature
provoke.what: Wrong, missing or old secret, or a replay; returns your status

advantages.title: No template review wait
advantages.text: Templates are approved, rejected or paused when you say, not after Meta's review queue.

advantages.title: Real error codes
advantages.text: 131047, 132000, 131026 and 190 come with Meta's titles, so the app's error handling is tested for real.

advantages.title: Someone on the other side
advantages.text: Replies, button taps, images and locations without a test phone or a second WhatsApp account.

advantages.title: Webhooks you can break
advantages.text: A wrong signature, an old secret or a replay shows whether the app really checks X-Hub-Signature-256.

agent.prompt: Make sure the order confirmation flow works when the customer taps "Talk to us".
steps: messages webhook signed, acme-api answered 200; window open for 24 h
tools: Messages both ways, with status history and the window
Wait for the app to send to a number; returns it
The person replies: text, button, image or location
Move a message to sent, delivered, read or failed
Is the 24 h window open for a number, and until when
Approve, reject, pause or disable a template
The next sends fail: 500, 400, reset, empty, timeout
A webhook the app must reject
Every Graph call gets 190 until restored

notes: Templates live in whatsapp/templates.yaml; no review by Meta happens here.
Port 8025 serves WhatsApp together with the screen, /api and /mcp.
